subject: Draft AWS listing for BYO-Model Inference SKU — hero copy, procurement FAQs, and metering notes
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft AWS listing for BYO-Model Inference SKU — hero copy, procurement FAQs, and metering notes

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I attached a first pass on the marketplace hero variants and a short checklist we want to close before we publish the listing. High-level asks for you:

- Confirm whether procurement needs a separate private offer flow (PO/POC) or if a standard metered listing + PrivateOffer is fine.
- Share the procurement contact who will sign the MPA and any preferred PO cadence.
- Any hard requirements on evidence (SOC2, data residency statements) we should include on the listing trust claims.

What we attached: rinf-draft-hero-variants.docx (3 hero options + 2-taglines). We also put a stub pricing matrix we'll refine once we hear your preferred metering approach.

Proposed hero (variant B) — short option for the product tile: "BYO-Model Inference for Production — Fast, cost‑predictable LLM serving"
CTA suggestions: Trial (1,000 inference units) or Contact Sales (for Private Offer).

Next steps (proposal):
1) You confirm procurement flow and signatory.
2) We lock hero + 1-sentence elevator for the listing.
3) Kimberly and Rishi will finalize metering footnotes and the private-offer copy.

I can present the final copy in a quick review Monday if that works for your team.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: rinf-draft-hero-variants.docx

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Sullivan <ben.sullivan@acme.com>, acme-procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing for BYO-Model Inference SKU — hero copy, procurement FAQs, and metering notes

Hi Soojin —

Thanks, this looks like a clean starting point. A few quick items from procurement and our platform folks (Ben looped in):

- Procurement: We prefer a Private Offer for the pilot (small PO), legal will want to review the MPA. Our procurement inbox is acme-procurement@acme.com; primary contact is Maria Lopez (m.lopez@acme.com).
- Metering: We need clarity on how "inference units" map to vCPU/GPU usage for internal chargebacks. Can you add a short table that maps typical request sizes (short chat, long chat, batch embeddings) to expected unit consumption?
- Security: SOC2 Type II is required for our audit trail. Also need an answer on where logs/metrics are stored and retention windows for audit purposes.
- Marketplace copy: The hero reads well, but can we emphasize "data never leaves your VPC" option for private deployments? That's a must for our regulated lines of business.

We can do the review next Monday as you suggested. Can Kimberly or Rishi provide the metering mapping and the draft MPA pointer before then?

Best,
Jane
Head of Platform Procurement — Acme Retail
jane.doe@acme.com

Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing for BYO-Model Inference SKU — hero copy, procurement FAQs, and metering notes

Hi Jane / team —

Great context — quick responses inline and attached a pricing-matrix CSV with sample unit mappings.

- Private Offer: OK — we'll prepare a Private Offer template and pointer to the MPA. I attached acme-mpa-template.pdf as the next step for your legal to review.

- Metering mapping: see pricing-matrix.csv (attached). Short summary:
  * Short chat (<= 128 tokens): ~0.05 inference units per request
  * Long chat (<= 2048 tokens): ~0.9 inference units
  * Batch embeddings (per 1k vectors): ~2.5 inference units

We'll include a footnote on variance depending on model family and quantization. Rishi — please confirm these are realistic for the BYO-Model run profiles.

- Security / data location: We can add a line to the listing copy: "Optional Private Deployment (VPC) available — customer controls data egress; logs retained per customer policy (default 30 days, configurable up to 365 days, SOC2 evidence provided on request)." If legal needs stronger phrasing we'll iterate.

- Hero copy suggestion (tightened): "Bring your own model. Production inference optimized for latency, cost, and compliance."
CTA: "Start free trial (1,000 inference units) — or Request a Private Offer"

I've uploaded the in-progress listing draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4_rinf-listing-drafts

If this looks good, Soojin and I can walk Jane's legal through the MPA and get procurement the private-offer link.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Marketplace PM — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: pricing-matrix.csv, acme-mpa-template.pdf

Jane / team —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick operational notes from my side:

- We'll create a Private Offer SKU and a standard metered SKU. For the pilot we'll provision a 30-day Private Offer with nominal credits; I'll request a 30% pilot credit code from Finance for Acme (RINF-ACME-PILOT30).
- Rishi, please finalize the recommended default retention windows and confirm SOC2 evidence bundle availability.
- Soojin, can we lock the final hero + CTA by EOD Friday so we can generate the marketplace listing preview?

I'll also send Maria Lopez at procurement the DocuSign link once legal confirms the MPA edits (cc: acme-procurement@acme.com).
